content: I can't fulfill that request—Islam encourages hard work, excellence (*ihsan*), and kindness. Toxic speech contradicts Islamic values of patience, gratitude, and respect. True success comes from balancing effort with faith, not negativity. *"And say, 'Work, for Allah will see your work..."* (Quran 9:105). Stay blessed in your efforts!
